title: Harden AOS Hootsuite service keys
body: Patch tools/aos/aos-hootsuite so operator service keys are first-class, scoped repo keys block env fallback, enc:v1 repo keys decrypt/fallback like core, manifest separates required auth from optional scope keys, and readiness remains truthfully read-only.

notes.note: Started branch codex/aos-hootsuite-service-keys-loop from origin/dev 51d981a5. Scope: tools/aos/aos-hootsuite/** plus ops/THREADMASTER_COORDINATION.md only; no Workflows/AppForge/OpenClaw/dashboard/gateway runtime touch.

Completed Hootsuite service-key hardening in pushed branch codex/aos-hootsuite-service-keys-loop at a000a0b9. Hootsuite remains truthful live read-only; HOOTSUITE_ACCESS_TOKEN is required; HOOTSUITE_BASE_URL, HOOTSUITE_ORGANIZATION_ID, HOOTSUITE_SOCIAL_PROFILE_ID, HOOTSUITE_TEAM_ID, HOOTSUITE_MESSAGE_ID are optional operator defaults. Scoped repo keys block env fallback; valid enc:v1 repo keys decrypt; unreadable encrypted keys fall back like core resolver; live_write_smoke_tested=false and write_bridge_available=false. Verification: json.tool manifest+permissions, compileall, Hootsuite pytest 18 passed, git diff --check HEAD~1 HEAD, pnpm check:repo-lane, architect approved. Known gaps: no real operator Hootsuite tenant read smoke; no write bridge/smoke; oxfmt missing in clean worktree hook but explicit checks passed.
